# minicoro

Unmodified `minicoro.h` from https://github.com/edubart/minicoro, pinned to commit
`02dad0f8b7cbb12fe6e216ae7a76db15ca55cd7b`.

SHA-256: `c4205e8db0a95456dfde9f73f071609c6d2cad2ebfd1d74ed0a9254f121caa2f`.

The header includes the upstream Public Domain / MIT No Attribution licenses.
We use the MIT No Attribution option. Only `runtime/scheduler.c` defines the
implementation, with virtual memory stacks and no library debug logging.
